newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Clear majority in Sweden against EMU - minister.
newsitem.headline: Clear majority in Sweden against EMU - minister.

text.p: Swedish Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said on Thursday the majority of Swedes were against joining the European Union's Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).

Asbrink, saying he expected the governing Social Democratic Party's leadership to take a decision on membership next spring, told Swedish television: "There is no doubt that today we have a negative majority against currency union".
Asbrink declined to disclose his own opinion on the EMU issue.
"I will be making my recommendation as a finance minister and member of the government in good time," he said, adding that the government would take a firm stance sometime in the spring.
